definitions.gloss: sense of shame; modesty; feelings of embarrassment
definitions.explanation: The innate feeling of shame or embarrassment that prevents a person from behaving in an improper or indecent manner. A psychological and moral concept.

examples.japanese: {羞恥心|しゅうちしん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My face turned red from embarrassment.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{羞恥心|しゅうちしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧だろう⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Does that person have no sense of shame?

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{平気|へいき}→平気：00095_heiki⟧だったこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{羞恥心|しゅうちしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦ようになる→ようになる：28408_youninaru⟧。
examples.english: Things that didn't bother you as a child start to cause feelings of shame as an adult.

notes:
USAGE:
{羞恥心|しゅうちしん} refers to the internal feeling of shame or modesty. It is often discussed in the context of social behavior, psychology, or moral character. Having no {羞恥心|しゅうちしん} is seen as a character flaw.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {羞恥心|しゅうちしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel shame)
- {羞恥心|しゅうちしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to have no sense of shame)
- {羞恥心|しゅうちしん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (out of shame)
- {羞恥心|しゅうちしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧ (to cast off one's shame)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{恥|はじ}→恥：12636_haji⟧: shame, disgrace (more general)
- {恥|は}ずかしさ: embarrassment, shyness
- {廉恥|れんち}: sense of honor and shame (literary)
